callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Mei Larsen. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
Build the board, day after day. The pattern will step forward.
✨ Ability gained: Ember Heart (L1). Once per fight, when a blow would kill you and you have 600 kcal banked, the furnace eats it instead: 600 kcal burn and you stand back up at 20% HP.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. they do not trust this coalition with their people. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge answers! Lena Frost and Lena Ali will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Cole Mendez and Priya Dubois will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Fanny steps forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Fanny marches with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 5 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
Packed: 1 Tribute grain from Stonebridge. (500 kcal, 0.0 kg)
🍽️ The muster is hungry — 500 of 5,000 kcal fed. Bellies remember who feeds them. (loyalty strains when the food runs thin.) (trust −2 per fire per day while the muster stands hungry.)
